entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi, Alex. I... I need to make a return for my VeloBand Pulse monitor. I just haven't even had a chance to use it.
I can certainly look into that for you. I just need to pull up your account. First, can you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
Oh, it's nothing like that. It's not a fault with the band. The thing is, I had a medical emergency right after it arrived. I was in the hospital for a week.
I'm very sorry to hear that. I hope everything is okay now.

I'm recovering. It was an unexpected surgery to make sure I was cleared for a potential deployment later this year. The timing was just terrible. This was a big purchase for me, and I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for a while... I really could use that money back right now.
I completely understand, and I appreciate your loyalty to VeloFit. Let me just pull up the order details and check the policy for you. One moment.
Alright, I see the order here. The VeloBand Pulse was delivered 11 days ago, on December 22nd. Let me just check the policy... Okay, yes. You're perfectly fine.
I am? So I can return it?

Absolutely. Our knowledge base shows that all items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery. You are well within that window, so I can process a full refund for you right now. No problem at all.
Oh, that's such a relief! Thank you so much, Alex. I was so worried because of the whole hospital situation.

Not a problem at all. I'm glad I could help resolve this for you. I've just initiated the return. You'll receive an email with a prepaid shipping label within the hour. Just pack the item in its original box and drop it off.
That's wonderful. You've really helped me out today. Thank you again.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was everything. Have a great day.
You too. And I wish you a speedy recovery. Thanks for calling VeloFit.
